Misato Katsuragi (葛城 ミサト, Katsuragi Misato ? ) is one of the main characters from the Neon Genesis Evangelion franchise. She is the operations director at NERV , initially with the rank of captain; she is later promoted to major. Her duties at NERV include acting as a field commander for the EVA pilots, issuing orders and relaying battle strategies as well as processing input from Ritsuko Akagi and the technicians monitoring the EVAS. itens.trecho: Shinnosuke Nohara (野原しんのすけ), also known as Shin-chan [しんちゃん] or just Shin , is the titular main protagonist of Crayon Shin-chan . He is the son of Hiroshi and Misae. His nickname is "Shin-chan" and he is Himawari's older brother. A kindergarten-aged boy whose antics are the basis for the series. He is five years old and yet acts overly mature. He knows the adults' words (does not always fully understand the meaning though), and hints at his somewhat deep philosophy in between dumb behavior. In general, he is brutally honest, highly curious, and has no shame whatsoever. Ironically, there have been several instances in which Shinnosuke's own crazy antics actually solved the problems of those around him. itens.trecho: Muzan Kibutsuji ( 鬼 ( き ) 舞 ( ぶ ) 辻 ( つじ ) 無 ( む ) 惨 ( ざん ) , Kibutsuji Muzan ? ) is the main antagonist of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba . He is the Demon King, the progenitor of all other demons in existence, and the leader of the Twelve Kizuki , an organization made up of the twelve strongest demons under his direct command. [ 5 ] A millennium ago during the Heian period , Muzan was turned into a demon from an experimental treatment for his terminal illness he's had since birth [ 1 ] and his goal ever since then has been to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. [ 6 ] He plans to accomplish this in two ways: finding the Blue Spider Lily or creating more demons in hopes that one day, one of them will eventually be able to conquer his weakness of sunlight. [ 7 ] [ 8 ] It is later revealed that Muzan is also of the same bloodline as the Ubuyashiki Family . [ 9 ] ↑ 1.0

His Japanese first-person pronoun is 「俺」 (ore), but with relatives or people he has known since childhood, he switches to 「僕」 (boku). Quick Answers What is the main goal of James and his trio in Team Rocket? James, part of Team Rocket, has a mission to seize rare and potent Pokémon, aiding their criminal organization's ambition for global control. The trio, including James, specifically targets to snatch Ash's Pikachu. Their methods include capture, theft, and performing unethical experiments on Pokémon to boost their power. itens.trecho: Kazuma Kuwabara ( 桑原和真 , Kuwabara Kazuma ? ) , more commonly known by his last name as Kuwabara , is one of the main protagonists of the series, along with Yusuke Urameshi , Kurama and Hiei . He is the younger brother of Shizuru Kuwabara . He also seeks to become Yukina 's lover. Quick Answers What is the relationship between Yusuke and Kuwabara in the series? In the YuYu Hakusho series, Kazuma Kuwabara and Yusuke Urameshi transition from being rivals to becoming best friends. Their relationship is marked by regular disagreements, yet they maintain a deep bond of respect and camaraderie. This bond is showcased in the third episode of season one and is further emphasized in the series' final episode, where they share a light-hearted moment and Yusuke reveals his future aspirations to Kuwabara. itens.trecho: Ryo Saeba ( 冴羽 獠 , Saeba Ryō ) is a sweeper/mercenary and the titular character and main protagonist of the City Hunter series. He is the most feared sweeper and legendary crime fighter in town who is a master of hand to hand combat, weapon manipulation and warfare tactics. He would be almost unstoppable if not for his only weakness - women. In Shinjuku station, there is a chalkboard accessible to the public. If you require the services of City Hunter, you only need to write "XYZ", and they will find you.
